description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, Octane render, vibrant saturated colors, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Hungry looking Pteranodon head with a wide open beak
layer_3_action.action: The Pteranodon head is surrounded by a bright red fig-like ancient fruit, a large glossy dragonfly, a shiny silver fish, a small green lizard, and a purple-tinted cycad seed cone, each at geometric positions that form an invisible five-pointed star around the pteranodon head with a caption in bright red mixed case letters that reads Ptero Diets!
